title: Japan Launches Kaguya Lunar Spacecraft
summary: On September 13, 2007, Japan launched the Kaguya spacecraft to map the lunar surface in HD.

title: Microscope Powered by Quantum Computer
summary: Scientists are combining an electron microscope with a quantum computer to extract more information from each electron and protect fragile samples.

title: NASA-Backed Scientists Turn Plastic Waste Into Edible Cookies
summary: Researchers engineered yeast to convert PET plastic and agricultural waste into ingredients for protein-rich, 3D-printed cookies for deep-space missions.

title: Architect Labs Announces AI Tool for Rapid Chip Design
summary: Architect Labs claims its Redwood AI tool can reduce custom chip design time from years to weeks.

title: Molybdenum Quasi-POMs Enhance EUV Imaging Performance
summary: Researchers from NYCU and TSMC published a paper proposing molybdenum-based quasi phase-only masks to improve EUV imaging.

title: Startup Tests Semiconductor Manufacturing in Space Vacuum
summary: Startup Besxar completed its first SpaceX flight, successfully recovering wafer samples manufactured in space without contamination.

title: Researchers Model Advanced Packaging Underfill Performance
summary: Researchers published a paper on predicting the cure evolution and thermal endurance of highly filled epoxy underfill for semiconductor packaging.

title: Plans Proposed for £1bn Battery-Electric Train Fleet
summary: Plans have been submitted for a £1bn fleet of British-built battery-electric trains for the Transpennine Route Upgrade.

title: ToolDance Unveils X1 Desktop CNC Mill
summary: The new X1 desktop CNC mill features a 1,500W spindle, a nine-tool changer, and optional multi-axis machining capabilities.

title: SUNLU and INSLOGIC Launch i10 Filament Cabinet
summary: The new i10 storage cabinet holds up to 10 filament spools and regulates relative humidity between 10% and 45%.

title: Ellinikon Urban Regeneration Project Completes Courtyards Phase
summary: Europe's largest urban regeneration project, the Ellinikon in Athens, has completed its latest residential stage called the Courtyards.

title: Portland General Electric Launches Novel Wildfire Prevention Research
summary: Portland General Electric is starting a wildfire research program measuring live plant moisture levels to assess wildfire risks.

title: Hermeus Pairs Quarterhorse with Ramjet-X for High-Mach Testing
summary: Hermeus revealed plans for the Quarterhorse aircraft to launch the Ramjet-X test vehicle for high-speed flight testing.

title: NAO Deems UK £70bn Grid Upgrade Timetable Challenging
summary: A National Audit Office review concluded that the UK's planned £70bn electricity transmission network upgrades face a very challenging delivery timetable.

title: Infineon Samples Dual-Phase Smart Power Stage Family
summary: Infineon has introduced a dual-phase smart power stage family for AI accelerators exceeding a power density of 2 A/mm².

title: Pairing Digital Twin and Cobot for Remote AM Finishing
summary: Researchers tested a digital twin and cobot system to enable operators to remotely program and supervise metal additive manufacturing finishing.
